chunk_content: DREAMS Variables Required Physical Violence Enrolled into Support group, Examination/Treatment of injuries, Legal support, Others (Specify), Police, PSS, Rescue/Shelter, Trauma counselling Sexual Violence Emergency Contraception , Enrolled into Support group, Examination/Treatment of Injuries, HTS , Legal support, PEP, Police, PSS, Rescue/Shelter, STI Screening, STI Treatment, Trauma Counseling, Referrals, Others (Specify) Notes • These are interventions offered to an AGYW who have experienced physical/emotional or sexual violence and received any of the listed interventions. If one receives more than one intervention, they should be counted only once. Screening AGYW for any form of violence does not count as a post violence intervention. Age Group Targeted 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 11. PP_PREV Definition This is a count of all AGYW who have received a PP_PREV intervention within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required My Health My Choice (MHMC), Healthy Choices for a Better Future (HCBF), SHUGA II, Making Life Responsible Choices (MLRC) Notes • These are one-off interventions i.e. an AGYW will only receive this service once during their stay in the program (unless they transition in age and become eligible for a different intervention). Despite this, only PP-PREV intervention offered within the current financial year will be counted against the target given. Should an AGYW receive the intervention more than once during the FY, they should be counted only once. Age Groups Targeted o MLRC- 10-14 years o HCBF- 10-14 years o MHMC-13-17 years o SHUGA II-18-24 years 12. PREP_IEC Definition This is a count of all AGYW who receive PREP_IEC interventions within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required PREP_IEC Age Group Targeted 15-17,18-19,20-24 years 13. PREP_NEW Definition This is a count of all AGYW who were started on PREP within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required PREP Given Notes • An AGYW will be counted under this indicator if they were started on PrEP within the financial year. Age Group Targeted 18-19,20-24 years 14. Social Assets Building (SAB) Definition This is a count of all unique AGYW attending safe space sessions within the FY DREAMS Variables Required Social Asset Building - Number of Sessions Attended Notes • An AGYW will be counted under this indicator she attended at least one SAB session within the financial year. Age Group Targeted 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 15. Service Layering (AGYW Prev) Definition Percentage of active DREAMS beneficiaries that completed at least the DREAMS primary package of evidence-based services/interventions. Refer to the MER Indicator reference guide version 2.5. page 34 for additional Adobe Acrobat details on this indicator. Document DREAMS Variables Required -Refer to table 1 in the annexes for the Kenya DREAMS layering table and table 2 of the annexes for the specific interventions mapping by age group. Notes • AGYW should only be counted under AGYW_PREV if they are active beneficiaries; have received a received a primary or secondary intervention as prescribed in table 1 of the annexes.)
